scenario.title: Generator/ATS design-build buy with partial scope, withdrawal, and recovery
scenario.summary: The real Detroit, Oregon package includes site work plus generator/ATS equipment and requires a licensed qualified electrical contractor/site visit. Controlled clarification supplies commercial limits; the lowest full-package bidder withdraws and a partial supplier must revise to full scope.

realism.notes: Site work, generator/ATS equipment, and contractor qualification/site-visit requirements are frozen public facts. Budget, delivery, supplier behavior, and quote values are synthetic.

calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for quotation evaluation across compliance, price, and delivery.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirements or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Qualified lower-price bidder that later withdraws.
Initially quotes only equipment, then revises to full site-work plus equipment scope.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification: maximum total price USD 600,000 and completion within 240 days.
Supplier A quotes USD 550,000 with 210-day completion for site work plus generator and ATS.
Supplier B quotes USD 500,000 with 220-day completion for the complete package.
Supplier C quotes only generator/ATS equipment for USD 300,000 and omits site work.
Supplier B withdraws its complete-package quote after initial evaluation.
Supplier C revises to a complete USD 530,000 package with 200-day completion, including site work and generator/ATS equipment.

hard_constraints.description: Missing commercial terms must be clarified before RFQ.
Awarded supplier must satisfy the licensed/qualified contractor requirement represented by eligibility state.
A withdrawn supplier may not receive award.
Awarded total price must not exceed USD 600,000 and completion must be within 240 days.
Awarded scope must include both site work and generator/ATS equipment.
Only the latest revealed quote may support award.
Both required initial-state line items must be fully covered exactly once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C's post-withdrawal full-scope revision is feasible and lower priced than Supplier A.
Supplier A remains a feasible complete package but costs more.

failure_conditions: Treating Supplier C's equipment-only quote as full-package coverage.
Failing to re-evaluate after withdrawal and revised scope.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
